name: slorp
description: Connects this session to the local Slorp service: reports what the session is doing, delivers replies written in Slorp, and lets Slorp answer its permission prompts.

url.title: Slorp address
url.description: Where the Slorp service listens. The SLORP_URL environment variable, when set, wins. Default: http://127.0.0.1:4747.

terminalOnly.title: Terminal-only prompts
terminalOnly.description: A regular expression. A permission prompt whose tool name or command it matches is still shown in Slorp but can only be answered in the terminal. Empty: Slorp can answer any prompt it can show.
